the design of the architectures for joint RoF/PA compensation in order to improve the performance of the overall system in terms of adjacent channel power.

the use of a compensated RoF for the feedback signal can be considered a good solution to compensate for both the PA nonlinearities and RoF nonlinearities.

the joint predistortion of RoF and the PA with nonideal feedback is possible, and that a combined use of LMS and RLS algorithms is recommended.

the use of a compensated RoF for the feedback is the best choice for joint compensation.

joint compensation of RoF and power amplifier is possible with nonideal feedback, but it is necessary to use a RoF link with low nonlinear distortion for the feedback.
